WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-92.138753 42.14859, -92.138766 42.147393, -92.13882 42.145444, -92.138181 42.145435, -92.138274 42.141378, -92.138191 42.141378, -92.138228 42.13992, -92.138584 42.139965, -92.139066 42.140052, -92.139844 42.140207, -92.140431 42.140373, -92.140903 42.140539, -92.141242 42.140689, -92.14177 42.140945, -92.142132 42.141146, -92.150946 42.141299, -92.150804 42.148751, -92.138753 42.14859))', 4326) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN buffered_region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).min AS slope
FROM region_slope;

WITH garrison_geometry AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Garrison%' AND border_type = 'city'
  LIMIT 1
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM garrison_geometry)),
      1,
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM garrison_geometry))
),
lowest_slope_value AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Value(slope_rast, 1)) AS lowest_slope
  FROM slope_raster
)
SELECT
  (SELECT region_name FROM garrison_geometry) AS location,
  lowest_slope
FROM lowest_slope_value;
